'''Katarn armor Mark VII''' was a variant of [[Katarn armor]] used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

It was black with green-yellow markings, and was the only variant of [[Katarn armor]] that was still in use by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. However, it appeared that it wasn't common for the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] to receive any sets; instead, operatives tended to gain them.
